india_trends.title: BRICS Summit: How it started, expanded and grew into an 11-nation bloc with 40% of global GDP
india_trends.summary: From its humble beginnings as BRIC to an influential coalition of 11 nations, BRICS today stands poised to reshape global economic dynamics. With nearly 40% of the world's GDP, the upcoming 2026 Summit in India will be a pivotal moment for emerging economies.

india_trends.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled: BRICS Summit clash pushes 57th meet to October 7
